correctness.rationale: For cubic antiferromagnetic Ising spins, the exact single-flip cost is \(2J(3-2a)\), with \(a\) the number of equal-spin neighbors; blocking is equivalent to \(a\le1\). The explicit 16-state transfer \(T\) counts aligned edges in a rung and its forward legs. Its row-swap involution \(Q\) gives the Möbius closure by \(\operatorname{tr}(T^nQ)\), while \(\operatorname{tr}(T^n)\) gives the periodic closure. The exact symbolic characteristic polynomials of the two invariant sectors are \(t^6(t^2-z^2)(t^2-t-z^2)\) and \(t^4(t^2+t+z^2)\). Their power sums yield the displayed closed energy polynomials for all \(n\ge3\). Coefficient parity and the exceptional \(2z^n\) monomial prove the total-variation result; analytic Perron-root dominance proves entropy and the first two limiting cumulants. The packaged verification program executed exact symbolic determinants and independently exhaustive graph checks for \(3\le n\le9\). The finite tests are supplemental, not substitutes for the all-size transfer proof. No dynamics-of-attraction claim is made.

originality.rationale: The specific all-n Möbius-twisted metastable energy polynomial and its near-disjointness from the periodic boundary energy law were not implied by the inspected papers or the accessible prior claim comparisons. Kalinin–Berloff 2022 already gives the even-n Möbius ground degeneracy \(2n\) and it is not asserted as new. Even-n periodic antiferromagnetic ladders are gauge-equivalent to known ferromagnetic periodic-ladder blocked-state generating functions and are baseline, not independently novel. The contribution rests on the twisted-sector all-energy enumeration and parity distinction. The 1989 broad metastability-strip paper could not be inspected in full, which is a nontrivial residual coverage risk, not evidence of noncoverage.
residual_risks: Masui–Southern–Jacobs 1989 paper potentially contains a general finite-strip recursion whose specific homogeneous antiferromagnetic Möbius specialization could dominate; its full text could not be assessed.
Unindexed locally maximal-cut / matching-polynomial literature could contain a mathematically equivalent twisted count.
Independent verification of originality has not been performed.

value.rationale: The complete energy-resolved locally stable Ising census of the benchmark Möbius topology is a motivated, natural invariant of the metastable energy landscape. Changing one global seam separates the two blocked-state energy distributions into almost disjoint residue classes, while the entropy, mean bond frustration per rung, and variance density remain exactly the same in the thermodynamic limit. This topology-sensitive distinction is not a routine restatement of the known ground-state degeneracy or the known periodic-even baseline. It supplies an all-n benchmark for constrained local-search and spin-glass studies without claiming quench dynamics or experimental impact.
